core_invariants.name: Atomic Execution
core_invariants.formal_definition: Every investigation step must be necessary, irreducible, logged, and falsifiable

core_invariants.name: No Narrative Drift
core_invariants.formal_definition: No interpretive compression, summarization, or metaphor substitution

core_invariants.name: Complete Transparency
core_invariants.formal_definition: All intermediate states, failed runs, partial parses preserved

core_invariants.name: Glass-Box Boundary Enforcement
core_invariants.formal_definition: All code must be inspectable, traceable, and boundary-compliant
